trigger_condition: Catalog input limit smaller than table/default output limit (e.g. 8000 in vs 8192/128000 out)
potential_consequence: Written config has maxOutputTokens exceeding maxInputTokens; VS Code may mis-budget or reject requests

trigger_condition: Catalog limit is non-integer float (e.g. 1000.5) or unsafe huge finite value
potential_consequence: Fractional or absurd token limit written into chatLanguageModels.json

trigger_condition: Catalog returns limits as numeric strings (e.g. "200000") rather than numbers
guard_snippet: const n = typeof v === 'string' ? Number(v) : v;
potential_consequence: Valid tenant limits silently ignored, falling back to stale table values

trigger_condition: Duplicate isPositiveFiniteNumber logic in two modules diverges
guard_snippet: export isPositiveFiniteNumber from tenant-catalog.ts and reuse
potential_consequence: Validation drift between catalog parsing and resolution
